title: Orthogonality of a nearest-point residual
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime and let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite with its extended nonarchimedean norm $|\cdot|_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $V$ be an $E$-vector space with a norm $\|\cdot\|:V\to\mathbf R_{\geq0}$ satisfying $\|av\|=|a|_E\|v\|$, $\|v+w\|\leq\max(\|v\|,\|w\|)$, and $\|v\|=0$ precisely for $v=0$. Let $n\geq0$ and suppose $b_0,\ldots,b_{n-1}\in V$ are linearly independent and satisfy the orthogonality formula
$$\left\|\sum_{i<n}a_i b_i\right\|=\max_{i<n}|a_i|_E\,\|b_i\|$$
for all $a_0,\ldots,a_{n-1}\in E$ (for $n=0$ the family is empty and both sides are $0$). Put $W=\operatorname{span}_E\{b_i:i<n\}$. Let $x\in V$ with $x\notin W$, and let $w\in W$ satisfy $\|x-w\|=\inf_{u\in W}\|x-u\|$. Then $b_n=x-w$ is nonzero and the displayed orthogonality formula holds for the enlarged family $b_0,\ldots,b_n$, that is, $\|\sum_{i\leq n}a_ib_i\|=\max_{i\leq n}|a_i|_E\|b_i\|$ for all $a_0,\ldots,a_n\in E$; in particular $b_0,\ldots,b_n$ are linearly independent and span $W+Ex$.
